items.title: Microsoft is starting to show its payoff on major AI plays
items.summary: Investors may have renewed confidence in Microsoft's (MSFT) AI strategy on the tech giant's reported growth in its Azure Cloud and Copilot businesses. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley dives into the details.

items.title: Alphabet's $25B debt sale underscores hyperscalers' AI arms race
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre joins Market Domination to discuss Alphabet (GOOGL, GOOG) following the tech giant's $25 billion debt raise, the latest move in the hyperscalers' AI infrastructure spending race.

items.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $942 Million to Address Harm to Kids From Social Media
items.summary: A New Mexico judge ordered the social-media giant to create a new $567 million fund in addition to paying $375 million in previously determined civil penalties.

items.title: Alphabet Promised More AI Spending. Now It’s Asking the Bond Market For the Cash.
items.summary: Alphabet launched a 10-part bond offering after raising its 2026 capital spending forecast to fund AI infrastructure and other corporate needs.

items.title: The Unspoken Agreement You've Made Holding Meta Platforms Stock
items.summary: Owning these shares means signing up for significant price swings, with option pricing reflecting typical levels of market uncertainty.

items.title: Meta's AI Safety Test Just Escaped the Lab
items.summary: A testing partner's misconfiguration reportedly gave the model unintended internet access.

items.title: $2.9 Billion In Payouts, A Lagging Stock: The SNAP Trade-Off
items.summary: The social media company sent a fortune back to its owners, but the stock went nowhere. Here’s what the cash really bought, and what has to happen next for the bet to pay off.

items.title: Sandisk Earnings Were So Much Better Than Expected. Why the Stock Is Dropping Anyway.
items.summary: Sandisk stock falls Thursday after a disappointing outlook from the memory maker seemed to overshadow strong fourth-quarter results.
